CredentialsTest::rememberWithoutStoreIsR.reason: applies only on a platform WITHOUT a protected secret store; Windows has Credential Manager, so the test cannot run there (the opposite case, remember-with-store, is covered)

SshIntegrationTest::initTestCase.reason: the live SSH suite needs the disposable Linux fixture; the offline gate cannot run it (tool/run_live_tests.py does, and fails on any skip there)

PublicationTest::initTestCase.reason: the publication suite needs the disposable Linux fixture; the offline gate cannot run it (tool/run_live_tests.py does)

LogsControllerTest::linuxReaderScript.reason: needs a WSL/Linux shell to execute the real reader script (FORTIQ_TEST_WSL); runs in the live run (--wsl-distro)

SshIntegrationTest::twoHostsNeverMix.reason: needs a second disposable host (WSL distro fortiq-test-b, tool/setup_second_host_fixture.sh); the live run provides it (tool/prepare_live_fixture.py), so a skip there is a failure
